contentHtml:
More individuals now prefer zero-deposit rentals. Why? Because they want freedom without freezing a chunk of money in a security hold. Rent a car without deposit Abu Dhabi, is great for a short weekend trip. You can take it on rent for a few weeks, or plan a monthly ride without upfront costs. Abu Dhabi has tons of flexible and budget-friendly options to choose from.

Get the latest information on how no-deposit rentals work. We list down the most popular companies, real prices, required documents, and tips. In the end, you’ll be in a position to decide on the best deal.

No Deposit Car Rental in Abu Dhabi Explained:

Taking the car without paying a security deposit up front is called a no-deposit car rental. It means no blocked amount on your card, no stress about refunds. The only responsibility on your shoulders is to pick up the car and drive.

How No Deposit Car Rentals Work?

Rental companies shifted to a zero deposit model in the year 2026. You pay only the rental cost. Usually, basic insurance is included with any optional add-ons. Rental companies verify your ID and driving status instead of a deposit. They also offer flexible insurance packages.

What are the Benefits of Renting Without a Deposit?

Skipping the deposit part will give you plenty of benefits. Let’s find out what those are

Save Your Money for Other Expenses

Since the company doesn’t hold 500–2000 dirhams as a deposit. Therefore, you keep that money free for:

  • Fuel
  • Plans, or
  • Travel spending.

Faster Booking Process

Bookings are quick with no deposit formalities. Quite helpful for travellers landing in Abu Dhabi.

No Credit Card Hold Hassles

You’re free from any lengthy “refund waiting times,” no blocked limit on your card, and no risk of deduction disputes.

Top Companies Offering Car Rental Without Deposit in Abu Dhabi

Now, many UAE rental companies provide daily, weekly, and monthly car rental in Abu Dhabi without deposit options. IZI Rent a Car is operating across the UAE with its wide range of car collection. They have gained popularity fast due to their affordable, customized, and quick services. Their flexible packages and deals made them the number one choice for individuals.

Hertz UAE is a major global rental-car brand. They have one of the largest fleets in the country and broad coverage across Abu Dhabi. Europcar is known for a wide selection of cars, ranging from economy to premium. They offer a good service and multiple pickup/drop-off locations to their customers.

Moreover, Thrifty Car Rental is present in Abu Dhabi and known for a varied fleet. You can enjoy budget-friendly cars or larger vehicles. The rental company is considered a reliable choice for both short- and long-term rentals. Avis is another long-standing international operator in the UAE with decent coverage. Famous for their stable fleet and reasonable options for everyday rentals. Enterprise Rent‑A‑Car has a smaller footprint than some global giants. However, they are generally regarded as reliable when you want simple service and well-maintained vehicles.

A detailed breakdown based on budget and car type has been discussed.

Budget-Friendly Options

Economy Car Rentals Starting from 45 dirhams per day

You can rent cars like Nissan Sunny, Yaris, Picanto, or Mirage at pocket-friendly daily rates with zero security deposit.

Compact and Mid-Size Vehicle Options

Cars such as Corolla, Elantra, and Mazda models are available through no-deposit plans. They start from 80 to 120 dirhams per day.

Luxury Car Rentals Without Deposit

Premium Brands Available

IZI Rent a Car, and other providers now offer luxury car rental in Abu Dhabi with no deposit options, including:

  • BMW
  • Mercedes, and
  • Audi.

Sports Cars and Convertibles

Need something special? You can also find Mustang convertibles or Camaro SS rentals under no-deposit plans. They are usually paired with full insurance coverage.

The Process to Rent a car without deposit Abu Dhabi

The process stays simple for both a resident and a visitor.

Required Documents for UAE Residents

As a UAE resident, you may require an Emirates ID, a UAE driving licence, a Debit/credit card, or cash payment.

Required Documents for Tourists

The tourists need to gather their passport, a visit visa or an entry stamp, a home country driving licence, or an International Driving Permit (for certain countries).

Step-by-Step Booking Process

  1. Search rental companies offering car hire in Abu Dhabi without a security deposit.
  2. Pick your preferred car and rental duration.
  3. Submit your documents through WhatsApp, website, or in-store.
  4. Select your insurance plan. The basic insurance plan is usually included.
  5. Make your payment and drive away with zero deposit.

Kinds of Vehicles Available for No Deposit Rentals:

You can take below cars on rent with no deposit.

Economy and Compact Cars:

Economy cars are perfect for daily commutes and city travel. These cars offer low fuel costs and cheaper daily rates.

SUVs and Family Vehicles:

Need more space? You can rent SUVs like:

  • Tucson
  • Sportage
  • Patrol, or
  • Fortuner

All without paying any deposit.

Luxury and Sports Cars:

For premium drives or business trips, choose brands like:

  • BMW
  • Audi
  • Range Rover, or
  • Mercedes

They are available under flexible no-deposit plans.

Pricing Guide: Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Rentals:

Explore the different car rental rates without a deposit:

Daily Car Rental Rates Without Deposit:

Searching for a daily car rental in Abu Dhabi with no deposit? Find them below:

  • Economy cars: AED 45–75/day
  • SUVs: AED 120–200/day
  • Luxury cars: AED 350–900/day

Prices vary based on models, KM limits, and insurance type.

Weekly and Monthly Rental Discounts:

Weekly rentals are 20 to 30 percent cheaper than daily rates. Monthly car rental in Abu Dhabi without a deposit starts from 1100 to 1600 dirhams per month for economy cars. Monthly plans offer the best value. The price includes free servicing and replacements. The prices vary from provider to provider.

Perks of No Deposit Car Rental in Abu Dhabi

The main perks you’ll get from no deposit car rental are as follows:

Financial Flexibility

You don’t lock money into a deposit. This makes it great for everyone, a traveller, a student, or a temporary resident.

Hassle-Free Experience

Pick the car, show papers, sign the agreement, and go. No waiting for refunds or approvals.

Free Additional Services

Many rental agencies now include:

  • Free roadside assistance
  • Free car replacement
  • Free maintenance
  • No hidden deposit deductions

Important Tips for Renting a Car Without a Deposit

  • Always read the rental contract to understand KM limits.
  • Check insurance coverage — upgrade if needed.
  • Inspect the car before driving.
  • Compare daily vs. monthly plans to save more.
  • Choose reputable companies to avoid surprise fees.

Blog Summary:

The guide is for those who are on the hunt for a reliable option to rent a car without a deposit in Abu Dhabi. Your search will end after reading our guide. You’ll find your perfect match here. There are tons of companies offering daily, weekly, and monthly no-deposit plans. It’s up to you to choose based on your requirements.

Require help? Team up with IZI Rent a Car. With us, you’ll get a flexible and budget-friendly rental experience. FAQs

Can tourists rent a car without a deposit in Abu Dhabi?

Tourists can easily rent a car without paying a deposit as long as they provide the required documents.

What documents do I need to rent a car without a deposit in Abu Dhabi?

To take a car on rent, you need a:

  • Passport
  • Visit visa
  • Home country licence
  • An International Driving Permit

Are there age restrictions for no-deposit car rentals?

Most companies require drivers to be 21 or older. Further, luxury cars require drivers to be 25 or older.

Is insurance included in no-deposit car rentals?

Basic insurance is normally included in no-deposit car rentals. However, you can upgrade to full coverage for extra safety.

Can I rent a luxury car in Abu Dhabi without paying a deposit?

Yes, You can rent a luxury car without paying a deposit. Many companies offer luxury car rental in Abu Dhabi with no deposit options and full insurance.

How much does it cost to rent a car without a deposit in Abu Dhabi?

Economy cars start from 45 dirhams per day. Monthly rentals begin at 1100 to 1600 dirhams per month. The prices vary from company to company.
